name: Dokkōdō
desc:
Dokkodo is a game that immerses players in the compelling narrative of Vagabond. Journey through the awe-inspiring realm of feudal Japan as a Samurai.
>> It requires Skill, do not expect it to be easy. <<

___________________________________________

Controls (PC / Controller)

Lock-On:             Middle Mouse | R3
Attack:                LMB | RT
Guard (Hold):      RMB | LT
Heavy Attack:     R | RB
Shove:                 G | LB
Stances:              F | Y
Sprint:                 W+W | L3
Dash:                   Q | B
Roll:                     Q+Q | B+B
Parkour (Hold):   Space | X
Inventory:           Tab | D-Pad Left (Hold)
Map:                    M | D-Pad Down (Hold)
Horse:                  H | D-Pad Right (Hold)
